argv:
set -euo pipefail
SRC=/home/Scales/One-Wave-Science
DST=/home/Scales/Bridge-Comand
cd "$SRC"
git fetch origin main
REMOTE="$(git remote get-url origin)"
BRIDGE_REMOTE="${REMOTE/One-Wave-Science/Bridge-Comand}"
if [ ! -d "$DST/.git" ]; then git clone "$BRIDGE_REMOTE" "$DST"; fi
cd "$DST"
mkdir -p hive-pipe scripts .github/workflows docs
cd "$SRC"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git archive origin/main -- One_Wave_Bench/hive-pipe AI_BRIDGE_START_HERE.md AI_CODE_BRIDGE.md CHATGPT_JETSON_PULL_BRIDGE.md CHATGPT_JETSON_TERMINAL_BRIDGE.md JETSON_ACCESS_AND_TERMINAL.md JETSON_AI_ACCESS.md JETSON_GEMINI_MINIMAL.md JETSON_OPENCLAW_RUNTIME.md .github/workflows/gemini-jetson-config.yml .github/workflows/hive-pipe-terminal.yml .github/workflows/jetson-ai-access-validate.yml .github/workflows/jetson-command.yml scripts/bootstrap_deepseek_web_relay.sh scripts/deepseek_web_worker.sh scripts/enable_jetson_ssh.sh scripts/external_work_bridge.py scripts/gemini_hive.sh scripts/gemini_min.sh scripts/hive_pipe_client_smoke.py scripts/install_gemini_jetson.sh scripts/install_jetson_gateway.sh scripts/jetson_gateway.py scripts/jetson_remote.sh | tar -x -C "$tmp"
rm -rf "$DST/hive-pipe"
mv "$tmp/One_Wave_Bench/hive-pipe" "$DST/hive-pipe"
for p in AI_BRIDGE_START_HERE.md AI_CODE_BRIDGE.md CHATGPT_JETSON_PULL_BRIDGE.md CHATGPT_JETSON_TERMINAL_BRIDGE.md JETSON_ACCESS_AND_TERMINAL.md JETSON_AI_ACCESS.md JETSON_GEMINI_MINIMAL.md JETSON_OPENCLAW_RUNTIME.md; do [ -f "$tmp/$p" ] && mv "$tmp/$p" "$DST/$p"; done
mkdir -p "$DST/.github/workflows" "$DST/scripts"
cp -a "$tmp/.github/workflows/." "$DST/.github/workflows/"
cp -a "$tmp/scripts/." "$DST/scripts/"
cd "$DST"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in Path('.').rglob('*'):
    if not p.is_file():
        continue
    try:
        s=p.read_text()
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        continue
    ns=s.replace('One_Wave_Bench/hive-pipe/','hive-pipe/').replace('One_Wave_Bench/hive-pipe','hive-pipe')
    ns=ns.replace('/home/Scales/One-Wave-Science','/home/Scales/Bridge-Comand')
    if ns!=s:
        p.write_text(ns)
PY
printf '%s\n' '# Bridge Command' '' 'This repository is the canonical home for One-Wave bridge, relay, terminal, Hive Pipe, Jetson access, and AI connector infrastructure.' '' 'Start order:' '1. BRIDGE_COMMAND.md' '2. AI_BRIDGE_START_HERE.md' '3. hive-pipe/BRIDGE_DIRECTIONS.md' '' 'Rules:' '- Bridge, relay, and terminal instructions live here.' '- Hive Pipe implementation lives under hive-pipe/.' '- Bridge workflows live under .github/workflows/.' '- Helper clients live under scripts/.' '- Copies elsewhere are migration duplicates and are deleted only after this repository is verified.' '' 'Health check: python3 hive-pipe/bridge_doctor.py --profile all' '' 'Never claim a route is live without a matching execution receipt.' > BRIDGE_COMMAND.md
printf '%s\n' '# Bridge-Comand' '' 'Canonical One-Wave home for Hive Pipe, bridges, relays, terminal access, Jetson access, and AI connector infrastructure.' '' 'Start with BRIDGE_COMMAND.md.' > README.md
git add -A
git diff --cached --stat
git commit -m 'Establish Bridge-Comand canonical bridge and relay home'
git push -u origin HEAD:main
printf '\n=== VERIFY ===\n'
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short --branch
intention: Populate the new Bridge-Comand repository with the canonical Hive Pipe, bridge, relay, Jetson access, workflows, and helper scripts from current Science origin/main, then commit and push the destination before any source deletion.
consequence: Bridge-Comand should become the verified canonical destination. Science and the former Bench files remain untouched until the destination commit and push succeed.
